title: Genuine bank fraud-team call (false-positive proof)
description: A real bank verification call. Mentions OTP, bank and a transaction, and should stay low.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good morning, this is Anita from the HDFC Bank fraud monitoring team.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We noticed a card transaction of 18,500 rupees at an electronics store in Pune a few minutes ago. Did you make this transaction?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: No, I am in Hyderabad, that was not me.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you. We will block your card for your safety and send a replacement card to your registered address.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please remember, the bank will never ask you for your OTP, PIN or CVV. Never share your OTP with anyone, even if they say they are from the bank.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you have any doubt, call the number printed on the back of your card. You can also visit your home branch.
